tasks.CheckEvenNumbers: Identify even numbers in lst1 and odd numbers in lst2.
tasks.DetermineOutcome: Evaluate the result based on the exchanged elements to ensure all elements in lst1 are even.
tasks.ExchangeElements: Attempt to exchange elements between lst1 and lst2 to make all elements of lst1 even.

answer: def exchange(lst1, lst2):    even_numbers_needed = len([num for num in lst1 if num % 2 != 0]) > 0    odd_numbers_in_lst2 = [num for num in lst2 if num % 2 != 0]    while even_numbers_needed and odd_numbers_in_lst2:        lst1.append(odd_numbers_in_lst2.pop())        even_numbers_needed -= 1    return 'YES' if all(num % 2 == 0 for num in lst1) else 'NO'
